prompt: Game screenshot of a low-poly strategy game, camera high above and pitched 60 degrees down over a square tile grid. A coastal fortress: stone walls enclose a courtyard with three cannons on wooden carriages, a stone keep, a small harbour, two sailing ships offshore, calm sea around the island. Bold flat primaries: navy, white, signal red, mustard yellow, with four distinct team colours deep blue, purple, teal green and olive. Hard faceted geometry, no bevels, every object reduced to its simplest solid, like a board game piece. Hard clean light, crisp shadows, no gradients. Bold and graphic, a board game come alive. Flat shaded low poly, every object made of a few clean facets, no textures, no text, no UI.
